Stearns County GIS
Maps, addressing, data and more...
Geographic Information System (GIS) is a mapping technology which can be used to display and analyze geographic information.
The GIS Division of Property Services works to develop, implement, and maintain a GIS database for county departments, local government agencies, and the general public. Data is shared through online GIS Map Applications. Also, certain GIS layers are also available for download.
The GIS division will also assist with assigning a new 9-1-1 address for a property.

GIS layers available for download
Stearns County GIS data is available to the public free of charge and without the need for a license agreement. For more information, email Stearns County GIS .
Disclaimer: This data is made available on an "as is" basis, without express or implied warranty of any sort including, specifically, any implied warranties of fitness for a particular purpose, warranties of merchantability or warranties relating to the accuracy or completeness of the database(s).
Road Centerlines - October 15, 2026
This dataset (3 MB compressed ZIP file) contains the street centerlines for Stearns County .
Parcels - October 15 , 2026
This dataset (38 MB compressed ZIP file) contains the parcels for Stearns County .
City & Township Boundaries (MCD) - October 15 , 2026
This dataset (2 MB compressed ZIP file) contains the city and township boundaries for Stearns County .
Zoning Districts - October 15 , 2026
This dataset (27 MB compressed ZIP file) contains the zoning districts for Stearns County .
Stockpile Soils - January 2021
This dataset (56 MB compressed ZIP file) contains the "short-term" stockpile suitability for the soils in Stearns County as outlined in Minnesota Rule 7020.
Shoreland Overlay 300 Feet - January 2021
This dataset (3 MB compressed ZIP file) contains the shoreland overlay area for the protected rivers and streams in Stearns County .
Shoreland Overlay 1,000 Feet - January 2021
This dataset (1 MB compressed ZIP file) contains the shoreland overlay area for the protected lakes in Stearns County
